title: UNECA — Statistical Data Manager
summary: A composable data-visualization platform for statisticians to build and publish custom dashboards.
description: Built a data-visualization platform that lets statisticians build and publish custom dashboards. The composable interface lets users dynamically create charts, maps, and tables from millions of aggregated data points to communicate specific insights.

title: AfroChat — AI Assistant
summary: An AI-powered productivity assistant for proofreading, summarizing, and organizing tasks.
description: AfroChat is an AI-powered assistant designed to boost productivity by simplifying everyday tasks: enhancing communication with proofreading and clarity tools, streamlining information with quick summarization, and organizing schedules. Built with a user-centric design and intelligent automation.

title: Meditopia — Medical Records
summary: A centralized medical-record system for Ethiopia with appointments and prescriptions.
description: A centralized medical-record system for Ethiopia, letting patients and healthcare providers access records and information from anywhere in the country. Patients manage their medical info while providers access accurate, up-to-date data to provide better care — plus appointment scheduling and prescription management.

title: Atrons — Learning Together
summary: A platform for students to share, search, and choose tried-and-tested study materials.
description: Atrons is a platform where students can share, search, and choose from tried-and-tested materials, books, videos, and quizzes for their studies. Worked as Frontend Engineer delivering the landing experience and core flows.

title: AfroChat — Admin Dashboard
summary: Analytics dashboard tracking key metrics for the AfroChat web and mobile apps.
description: Designed and developed to provide comprehensive tracking of key metrics across the AfroChat website and mobile app. Robust analytics tools surface actionable insights from user statistics, empowering informed decision-making and optimized performance.

title: AfroChat — Telegram Chatbot
summary: The AfroChat AI assistant integrated into Telegram as a fully functional bot.
description: Developed a fully functional AI assistant chatbot as a web app integrated with Telegram, enabling seamless user interactions for tasks like summarizing, organizing, and proofreading.
